title: RSCIT Computer Course Rajasthan: Fees, Exam, Certificate
meta_description: RSCIT is Rajasthan's official basic computer course by VMOU Kota. Rs 4,200 fee, 3 months, 132 hours. Free for eligible women. Enroll at myrkcl.in.

hero.one_liner: RSCIT is Rajasthan's official basic computer course by VMOU Kota. Rs 4,200 fee, 3 months, 132 hours, recognised for state government jobs. Enroll at myrkcl.in.

what_is_it: RS-CIT stands for Rajasthan State Certificate in Information Technology and is the official basic computer literacy course recognised by the Rajasthan government. It is conducted by Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Limited (RKCL) and the certificate is issued by Vardhman Mahaveer Open University (VMOU), Kota.

The course is specifically designed for people who want to learn computer and internet skills at a foundational level. It is not a degree programme but a short-term certificate course that takes three months and 132 contact hours to complete.

eligibility.label: Who can join
eligibility.value: Anyone who can read and write. No minimum qualification, Class 10 desirable.

eligibility.label: Fee
eligibility.value: Rs 4,200 general, Rs 2,700 for eligible government employees.

eligibility.label: Free for women
eligibility.value: Eligible women can enrol free under state schemes via their RKCL centre.

eligibility.label: Duration
eligibility.value: 3 months, 132 hours, one hour theory and one hour practical a day.

eligibility_filters.notes: Open to anyone literate in Rajasthan, no minimum qualification. Fee Rs 4,200 (Rs 2,700 govt employees), free for eligible women under state schemes. Certified by VMOU Kota, conducted by RKCL through iLearn centres.

how_to_apply.title: Find an authorised RKCL iLearn Centre near you
how_to_apply.description: Visit myrkcl.in and use the centre locator to find an authorised RKCL iLearn Centre in your city or town. RSCIT is only available through these authorised centres and cannot be completed as a purely home-based course.

how_to_apply.title: Check eligibility for the subsidised or free fee
how_to_apply.description: If you are a woman or girl eligible under the Mahila Nidhi Swayam Sahayata Ko-Operative Societies scheme (MNSKSY) or another Rajasthan government subsidy, confirm your eligibility with the centre before paying the full Rs 4,200 fee. Government employees pay a reduced fee of Rs 2,700.

how_to_apply.title: Submit your documents and pay the fee
how_to_apply.description: Carry your Aadhaar card, a passport-size photograph, and your Jan Aadhaar card to the centre. Pay the applicable fee at the time of enrolment. You will receive an enrolment confirmation and login credentials for the online learning portal.

how_to_apply.title: Attend classes and complete the 132-hour curriculum
how_to_apply.description: The RSCIT course runs for three months with 132 contact hours at the iLearn Centre. Topics covered include Windows 11, MS Office 2019 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), internet browsing, email, cybersecurity basics, and an introduction to AI and machine learning concepts.

how_to_apply.title: Appear for the online theory exam
how_to_apply.description: The theory exam is conducted online through RKCL. It consists of 35 multiple-choice questions to be answered in 60 minutes. You must score at least 40 percent to pass the theory component. Exam dates are announced through myrkcl.in after registration.

how_to_apply.title: Complete the practical assessment
how_to_apply.description: A separate practical assessment is conducted at the iLearn Centre to test hands-on skills in MS Office and other tools covered in the course. You must score at least 40 percent in the practical component as well.

how_to_apply.title: Download your VMOU certificate
how_to_apply.description: After passing both components, your RS-CIT certificate is issued by Vardhman Mahaveer Open University, Kota. The certificate can be downloaded from the myrkcl.in portal and is accepted in Rajasthan government job applications and competitive exams requiring basic computer proficiency.

ministry: Department of Information Technology and Communication (DoIT&C), Rajasthan

extra_sections.heading: What Is the RSCIT Course
content: RSCIT is recognised in Rajasthan government job notifications as a valid basic computer certificate. Many state government departments and recruitment boards require candidates to hold an RS-CIT certificate or equivalent as a minimum qualification for clerical and administrative posts.

The course is taught in both Hindi and English, which makes it accessible to candidates across Rajasthan regardless of their English language background. Most instruction and study material is available in Hindi for candidates who are more comfortable in that medium.

The curriculum was updated to include Windows 11, MS Office 2019, and new topics on cybersecurity and artificial intelligence basics. This makes the RSCIT more relevant to current workplace and digital citizen requirements compared to older versions of the course.

RKCL operates a network of over 5,000 authorised iLearn Centres across all 33 districts of Rajasthan. This wide network means that most towns and blocks have at least one RKCL centre where candidates can enrol and attend classes.

extra_sections.heading: Who Can Join and the Fee
content: The practical component of the RSCIT exam tests hands-on skills rather than just theoretical knowledge. Candidates are assessed on actual tasks in MS Word, MS Excel, and internet applications, ensuring that certificate holders have genuine working ability in these tools.

The RSCIT certificate is issued under the authority of VMOU Kota, which is a government university established by the Rajasthan government. This official university backing gives the certificate credibility in both public sector recruitment and for personal digital skill documentation.

Candidates who fail the exam can re-attempt after paying a re-examination fee. The re-exam is conducted through the same online platform and follows the same 35-question, 60-minute format as the original exam.

The course covers email and internet usage, which is increasingly important for accessing government portals like Jan Soochna, DigiLocker, and UMANG. Candidates completing RSCIT are equipped to independently use these services for government applications and document access.

extra_sections.heading: The Exam Pattern
content: RSCIT is distinct from other computer courses offered by private institutes in Rajasthan because it is the only state-recognised certificate with official government validity in Rajasthan's recruitment framework. A certificate from a private training institute does not automatically carry the same recognition.

Students who complete RSCIT and want to go further can take the RKCL advanced course called RS-CFA (Rajasthan State Certificate in Financial Accounting) or other RKCL programmes. RS-CIT serves as a prerequisite or entry-level qualification for these advanced courses.

The course includes a module on cybersecurity awareness that covers topics like safe internet browsing, identifying phishing emails, and setting secure passwords. This module was added to address the rise in cyber fraud targeting new internet users in smaller towns and rural areas.

All RSCIT enrolment, exam scheduling, admit card download, result checking, and certificate download are handled through the myrkcl.in portal. Candidates should use this portal as the single reference point for all official information related to their course.

extra_sections.title: The RSCIT Exam at a Glance
extra_sections.desc:
The online exam has 35 objective questions worth 2 marks each, for 70 marks, in 60 minutes.

There is also a practical assessment on the same computers used in training. You can re-attempt the exam after paying a re-exam fee if you do not pass.

extra_sections.heading: Free RSCIT for Women
content: RSCIT is open to any person who can read and write, with no minimum qualification requirement. A student who has completed Class 10 or Class 12, a housewife learning computers for the first time, or a working professional wanting to update their skills can all enrol in the same course.

The three-month duration of the course is structured as weekly classes at the iLearn Centre. Most centres run morning and evening batches, allowing candidates who work during the day to still complete the course without disrupting their regular schedule.

Fee payment at enrolment is collected by the authorised iLearn Centre and forwarded to RKCL. Candidates should ask for an official fee receipt at the time of payment, as this receipt is required if there is any dispute about enrolment or exam eligibility later.
The online theory exam is conducted in a proctored environment at the iLearn Centre. Candidates are not permitted to use notes, books, or mobile phones during the exam.

extra_sections.title: Free for Eligible Women
extra_sections.content:
Eligible women and girls can take RSCIT free under Rajasthan state schemes such as the Mahila Nidhi Swayam Sahayata programme.

If you think you qualify, ask your nearest RKCL iLearn centre or gram panchayat about the free-enrolment categories before paying.

extra_sections.heading: How to Enrol
content: Results for the theory exam are typically available within a few days of the exam date on myrkcl.in. Candidates can check individual scores for both theory and practical components by logging in to the portal.

RKCL is a joint venture between the Rajasthan government and Infosys BPO, established to drive IT literacy across the state. Its network of authorised iLearn Centres covers all 33 districts, with over 5,000 active centres making it one of the largest IT training networks in India.

VMOU Kota, or Vardhman Mahaveer Open University, is a state government university established to provide open and distance education in Rajasthan. Its role in RSCIT is to issue the official certificate, which gives the qualification the status of a university-backed credential rather than just a private training certificate.

The course material for RSCIT is provided in both printed and digital form. Students receive a handbook covering all modules and also get access to the online study material through the myrkcl.in learning portal, where practice tests and video lessons are available.

steps.title: Find an iLearn centre

steps.desc: Attend weekly theory and practical classes over three months. There is a minimum attendance requirement to sit the exam.

steps.title: Exam and certificate

extra_sections.heading: What the Course Covers
content: The Windows 11 module covers the basic operating system interface, file and folder management, desktop customisation, and the use of built-in tools like Notepad and Paint. Students learn how to install and uninstall software, manage printers, and use the Windows settings panel for common adjustments.

The MS Word module teaches document creation, formatting text and paragraphs, inserting tables and images, using styles and templates, and saving and printing documents. Candidates learn how to prepare letters, reports, and official documents using the tools commonly required in government and office environments.

The MS Excel module covers creating and formatting spreadsheets, entering data, using basic formulas and functions, sorting and filtering data, and creating simple charts and graphs. These skills are directly useful for clerical, data entry, and administrative positions in both public and private sectors.

The MS PowerPoint module teaches creating and formatting presentation slides, using slide layouts and transitions, inserting images and shapes, and running slideshow presentations. This module is particularly useful for teachers, trainers, and anyone presenting information in professional settings.

extra_sections.heading: Why RSCIT Matters for Jobs
content: The internet and email module covers web browser usage, online searching, downloading and uploading files, creating and using email accounts, and understanding how to navigate government portals like DigiLocker and Jan Soochna. Candidates learn to use internet tools for both personal tasks and government service access.

The cybersecurity module is one of the newer additions to the RSCIT syllabus and covers identifying phishing attempts, setting strong passwords, understanding two-factor authentication, and recognising common online scams. This knowledge is especially valuable for candidates in semi-urban and rural areas who are becoming internet users for the first time.

The artificial intelligence and machine learning basics module introduces foundational concepts of AI without requiring any programming knowledge. Candidates learn what AI is, how it is used in everyday applications like recommendation engines and chatbots, and the social implications of automation.

The practical assessment at the iLearn Centre uses the same computers on which training was delivered throughout the course. The assessor gives candidates real tasks such as typing a document in MS Word, creating a formula in MS Excel, and browsing a specific website, and evaluates the work completed.

extra_sections.text: RS-CIT is not just a computer certificate; it is the key that opens the door to hundreds of Rajasthan government jobs that require basic computer proficiency. For women who enrol for free under the state scheme, it costs nothing but three months of commitment.

extra_sections.heading: RSCIT Compared and Validity
content: Preparing for the theory exam requires regular review of the RSCIT handbook and practice through the online mock tests available on myrkcl.in. The 35-question format with a 60-minute time limit rewards candidates who have practised answering quickly and reviewing their responses before submission.

Admit cards for the RSCIT exam are issued through the myrkcl.in portal and can be downloaded by logging in with the enrolment credentials. Candidates must bring a printed or digital copy of the admit card along with a photo ID to the exam venue.

The exam result is published on myrkcl.in within a short period after the exam date. Candidates can check their marks for both theory and practical components by logging in to the portal and navigating to their exam result section.

The RS-CIT certificate is a digitally signed document issued by VMOU Kota and can be downloaded from myrkcl.in after results are declared. The certificate includes the candidate's name, photograph, enrolment number, marks obtained, and the date of the examination.

extra_sections.title: More on Eligibility and Coverage
extra_sections.content:
Many Rajasthan government departments, including the Revenue department, District Collectorate offices, and state police clerical cadres, list RS-CIT as the required basic computer qualification. Candidates applying to these posts should download and preserve the certificate as it will need to be submitted or verified during the recruitment process.

The iLearn Centres that offer RSCIT are equipped with computers, internet connectivity, and a qualified trainer. Most centres run two or three batches per day, typically in the morning, afternoon, and evening, so candidates with varying schedules can find a batch that suits them.

RSCIT is often compared to the CCC (Course on Computer Concepts) certificate issued by NIELIT, which is a national-level basic computer course. In Rajasthan government jobs, RS-CIT is typically treated as equivalent to CCC, but candidates should always check the specific notification of the post they are applying for.

extra_sections.heading: What Else to Know
content: Candidates who move to a different city after enrolment but before completing the course can request a centre transfer through the myrkcl.in portal. The transfer is subject to availability at the new location and must be completed within the permitted window during the batch.

The RSCIT course has a minimum attendance requirement at the iLearn Centre. Candidates who miss too many classes may not be permitted to sit the exam, so regular attendance throughout the three-month period is necessary to remain eligible.

After completing RSCIT, candidates who want to build on their computer skills can explore the RS-CFA course offered by RKCL, which covers financial accounting software like Tally. This is useful for candidates interested in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance roles.

extra_sections.title: Practical Tips and Process
extra_sections.content:
RSCIT is primarily a Rajasthan-specific qualification and may not be universally recognised outside the state for job applications. Candidates applying for central government posts should verify whether they also need a NIELIT CCC certificate as RS-CIT and CCC are sometimes treated as equivalent but not always.

Within Rajasthan, the VMOU-issued RS-CIT certificate is the standard accepted computer qualification for state government recruitment. For most Rajasthan state posts requiring basic computer proficiency, RS-CIT alone is sufficient.

Women from economically weaker sections who want to enrol for free should contact their nearest RKCL centre or gram panchayat to understand the current applicable scheme. Eligibility conditions for free enrolment may change based on government budget announcements each year.

extra_sections.heading: Additional Details
content: RSCIT is also popular among school and college students who take the course alongside their regular studies. Many students complete RSCIT during summer holidays or between academic semesters so the course does not interfere with their main educational commitments.

For candidates who are already working in government offices and need to fulfil the RS-CIT requirement as part of their service conditions, RKCL centres near government offices typically have dedicated batches. The reduced fee of Rs 2,700 for government employees makes this accessible for in-service staff.

The exam is conducted multiple times a year at designated exam centres across Rajasthan. Candidates who miss their initially scheduled exam can request rescheduling through the portal, subject to seat availability in the next available exam batch.

faqs.question: What is RSCIT?
faqs.answer:
RS-CIT stands for Rajasthan State Certificate in Information Technology. It is a 3-month basic computer literacy course conducted by RKCL and affiliated with VMOU Kota.

The certificate is recognised in Rajasthan government job notifications as valid proof of computer proficiency.

faqs.question: What is the fee for RSCIT in 2025?
faqs.answer:
The standard fee for RSCIT is Rs 4,200. Government employees pay a reduced fee of Rs 2,700.

Women who qualify under the Rajasthan government's MNSKSY scheme can enrol for free. Fees are paid at the time of enrolment at an authorised RKCL iLearn Centre.

faqs.question: How do I enrol in RSCIT?
faqs.answer:
Visit myrkcl.in to find the nearest authorised RKCL iLearn Centre. Go to the centre with your Aadhaar card, Jan Aadhaar card, and a passport-size photograph.

Pay the applicable fee and get your enrolment confirmation and portal login credentials.

faqs.question: What is the RSCIT exam pattern?
faqs.answer:
The RSCIT theory exam is an online test of 35 multiple-choice questions to be completed in 60 minutes. A minimum of 40 percent is required to pass.

There is also a practical assessment at the iLearn Centre where hands-on skills in MS Office and internet tools are tested, also with a 40 percent passing mark.

faqs.question: Which certificate does RSCIT give?
faqs.answer: Candidates who pass both the theory and practical exams receive the RS-CIT certificate issued by Vardhman Mahaveer Open University (VMOU), Kota. The certificate can be downloaded from myrkcl.in and is accepted in Rajasthan government job and exam applications.

faqs.question: Is RSCIT free for women in Rajasthan?
faqs.answer: Yes, eligible women and girls can enrol in RSCIT for free under the Mahila Nidhi Swayam Sahayata Ko-Operative Societies scheme (MNSKSY) and other state government initiatives. Check your eligibility with the nearest RKCL centre or through myrkcl.in before paying the standard fee.

faqs.question: What topics are covered in RSCIT?
faqs.answer: RSCIT covers Windows 11, MS Office 2019 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), internet browsing, email, cybersecurity basics, and an introduction to artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts. The course is 132 hours over three months and is taught in both Hindi and English.

faqs.question: What is the official website for RSCIT?
faqs.answer: The official portal for RSCIT enrolment, exam schedules, admit cards, results, and certificate download is myrkcl.in. The helpline number is 0141-2705210 for queries about the course, centres, or enrolment.

faqs.question: Can I fail and retake the RSCIT exam?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Candidates who do not pass the theory or practical exam can re-attempt after paying a re-examination fee.

The re-exam follows the same format as the original exam and is scheduled through the myrkcl.in portal.

faqs.question: Is RSCIT valid for Rajasthan government jobs?
faqs.answer:
Yes. The RS-CIT certificate is accepted in Rajasthan government recruitment notifications that require basic computer proficiency.

Many state departments and recruitment boards specifically list RS-CIT or equivalent as the minimum acceptable computer certificate for eligible posts.
